source_documents.title: Enhanced Luminance of Pentaazaphenalene‐Based Delayed Fluorescence Emitters by Breaking Forbidden Transition

conditions_studied: solution: toluene and acetonitrile, 1e-5 M, O2 vs Ar

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, azaphenalenes are D3h /D3h -like structures and nonemissive because their electronic transition between S1 and the ground state (S0 ) is principally symmetrically forbidden, making it difficult to realize high luminescence efficiency (Tables S1 and S2).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 5AP core
reference_evidence_units.statement: The bare 5AP S0-S1 transition is symmetry-forbidden.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This cooperative interaction dramatically enhances the transition dipole moments and the f values
reference_evidence_units.subject: Pyr-5AP-CF3, Pyr-5AP-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Donor and acceptor substituents enlarge the HOMO-LUMO overlap and the oscillator strength (f: CN > CF3 > Br > 5AP).

reference_evidence_units.quote: ФPL s for Pyr-5AP-CF3 and Pyr-5AP-CN in toluene solution were 60.8% and 57.1%, respectively (Table 3), which were much larger than that of Pyr-5AP-Br (4.0%).
reference_evidence_units.subject: all three
reference_evidence_units.statement: ΦPL 60.8% (CF3), 57.1% (CN), 4.0% (Br); kr 6.4e7/8.0e7/3.6e7 s-1, knr of the Br compound 8.7e8 s-1 (Table 3).

reference_evidence_units.quote: design strategy successfully enhances emission by breaking the forbidden transition of 5AP.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Pyr-5AP-CF3, Pyr-5AP-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission is switched on by making the S0-S1 transition allowed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Pyr-5AP-CF3 and Pyr-5AP-CN exhibited no delayed components under an oxygen atmosphere but showed clear delayed emissions under argon (Ar) bubbling condition.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Pyr-5AP-CF3, Pyr-5AP-CN

reference_evidence_units.quote: the delayed fluorescence lifetimes (τ d ) of Pyr-5AP-CF3 and Pyr-5AP-CN were 9.5 and 7.5 µs, respectively, whereas no delayed component was observed for Pyr-5AP-Br
reference_evidence_units.subject: all three
reference_evidence_units.statement: µs delayed fluorescence for CF3/CN (kRISC ~1e5 s-1); none for the dibromide.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The solvent effects were negligible due to the predominantly short-range charge transfer nature of the transition between S0 and S1 , as confirmed by the theoretical calculations.
reference_evidence_units.subject: all three

mechanism_decisions.rationale: No delayed component is observed (E06); ISC is not discussed, so the family is not marked contradicted.

contrast_group.paper_difference: Aryl acceptors make the S0-S1 transition allowed (larger f and kr) and switch on emission (ΦPL 57-61% vs 4%) with TADF; the dibromide stays weakly emissive with no delayed component.
